This FloPlast 110mm push-fit adjustable bend is an essential component for effective soil and vent drainage systems. Manufactured from durable polypropylene, this double socket grey pipe bend offers a flexible 0 to 90° angle adjustment, making it ideal for navigating tight spaces or adapting to complex plumbing layouts in both new installations and renovation projects. The reliable push-fit connection with ring seal joints ensures a secure and watertight fit, simplifying installation for plumbers and drainage specialists. For optimal performance, the use of silicone lubricant on all seals is recommended to facilitate jointing.
